findings.description: The Lambda function embeds a literal AWS access key and secret key (AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE / wJalrXUtnFEMI/K7MDENG/bPxRfiCYEXAMPLEKEY) as environment variables. These secrets are stored in the Terraform source and state, and are retrievable in cleartext by anyone with lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration, so the credentials are effectively disclosed and cannot be rotated without a code change.

The function is configured with runtime "nodejs12.x", which is deprecated and no longer receives security patches from AWS. Running an unmaintained runtime leaves the function exposed to known, unpatched vulnerabilities in the language runtime and its dependencies.
